paragraphs: Rav Sherevyah: Pesahim 98a. He spoke to Abaye: Bekhorot 19a. Bava Metzia 64, end of side a. He sent to Abaye: Bava Batra 166b. He spoke to Rava: Yevamot 112a. In Rava's name: Yevamot, chapter 3; Shabbat 136b, where Ravina said to him. Ketubbot 102b; Kiddushin 9 beginning of side b, 48 end of side a: Rava and Ravina say she is betrothed; Rav Pappa and Rav Sherevyah say she is not betrothed. “There are two.” I do not know whence this is derived, for all those mentioned above were in one generation. Yuhasin writes in Rav Sherira Gaon's epistle: “Rav Sherevyah taught in the Kiddushin collection of Levi's academy.” I did not find this in the Talmud. It seems to me that it should read: Rav Shemayah bar Zeira taught in the Kiddushin collection of Levi's academy; see above.
